title: Playhead Next Fifty
rule: Ranked by the launch-window rule — the virgin-install first listen — then by what the 2026-09-08 field session pointed at. Rank is an order, not a score; items 1–8 carry the measurements, everything past ~25 is judgment. Fable is reserved for work where a wrong reading is expensive or the design is the product; opus for well-specified implementation; sonnet for mechanical work with a recipe; haiku for the trivial.

tiers.name: Settle the field reports
tiers.why: Five things Dan hit in one listening session. Two are fixed and shipped; these are the rest, in the order the evidence supports.

tiers.name: The first-listen path
tiers.why: Download → ✓ → play → byte-exact skip → card → one-tap correction. Anything that lies to the listener on that path, or strands the work that feeds it.

tiers.name: Earning the card
tiers.why: Precision and trust on the banner: what reaches a listener, what a tap does, what a correction is worth.

tiers.name: Finished before you press play
tiers.why: Reach and efficiency of the analysis lanes — wasted work, counters that name the wrong quantity, recovery that forgets.

tiers.name: The harness that catches all of the above
tiers.why: The gate, the battery, and the canaries. A rail that lies costs more than no rail.

items.title: The double runtime: two live playback transports for the whole session
items.reason: MEASURED 09-12: live=2 in all 186 census rows, at 60 s and at 31 min. Both runtimes are built before either bootstraps. Fix is idempotent per-process construction plus a one-file-per-launch rail; that is a process-wide slot on the runtime, so the shape wants your approval before it is built.

items.title: The midroll loop — the cue list is cleared, the player is not
items.reason: Two transports each observe item-finished and interruption with object: nil, so every end-of-item is handled twice. Fix #1, listen to the same episode, and add a durable ring of recent seeks so the next loop is readable from a pull.

items.title: The app stopping — relocated from process death to playback halt
items.reason: MetricKit delivered: zero crashes, watchdogs or signals since 09-08. The seven restarts were playback stopping, the idle app evicted, and a cold relaunch. Same investigation as #2.

items.title: 11 episodes scanned to 97–99% still read as unanalysed
items.reason: Decided 09-12: hand a retry-exhausted backfill job's coverage back to the session machine so the existing completeAdScanPartial transition fires. Verify that transition's condition is coverage-shaped before building; if not, come back with the reconciler option.

items.title: spliceLedLeadingAd — the tap that skips from your position to a proven splice
items.reason: Decided 09-12: build next, after the P0s. Reach going forward is ~60% of splice sites, not the historical 9. Five rails including an untypeable one. Closes 49zn0.

items.title: Privacy policy + support page — the two URLs App Store Connect requires
items.reason: Content shipped in #486. Your four steps: pick hosting, choose the support address, paste the URLs into the four ASC fields, read the pages before publishing. Gates external TestFlight.

items.title: The real price: ASC product, and paid-up-front vs free-download-plus-unlock
items.reason: StoreKit shows $49.99 since #498. Remaining are yours: the App Store Connect product price, and the model decision the listing's closing paragraph waits on.

items.title: The transcript selection made you mark the preroll twice
items.reason: A 0.65 s fragment at 15:32:19, then the rest at 15:33:33. This is the repair path; it should cost one gesture. Establish how a selection extends and whether 'to the end of this ad' can be offered.

items.title: Transcript floor 0.95, ad-scan floor 0.98, over the same quantity
items.reason: Raised to P1: 13 of the 27 abandoned backfill jobs sit at 97–99% with underCoverageBudgetSpent — the band this bead says can never certify. Measure which floor each hit; the number is yours.

items.title: Nothing deletes an asset row — a deleted download is a phantom 'queued' episode
items.reason: Same listener-facing symptom as #4 with a different cause. Activity shows an episode that cannot be analysed and has no job behind it.

items.title: Up Next strands an episode whose download was deleted before analysis
items.reason: Sibling of #10 on the Activity screen; likely the same delete path.

items.title: A suppressed window can still reach a banner and be confirmed
items.reason: One of ynmk's three false confirmations was decisionState=suppressed at tap time. A suppressed row must yield no card, and a row suppressed after a card is armed must retire the card.

items.title: Seven byte-exact rediff windows stamped both-edges-unanchored
items.reason: A proven skip demoted to mark-only by its own metadata. Backfill the stamps and add a persisted-state invariant.

items.title: Acoustic-only segments must earn their banner card
items.reason: 51 acousticRefined windows at confidence ≥ 0.95 with both edges unanchored, from a lane measured at 21% recall. Raise the promotion bar without removing the path.

items.title: decision-log.jsonl: 6,756 entries and zero for the field-report episode
items.reason: Dead since 08-24 while decision_events kept being written. It is the only per-window extent record; without it a proposal cannot be located in time.

items.title: The surface-status stream is used as a durability fallback and is not independent
items.reason: Same medium as analysis.sqlite; a fallback that shares the failure it guards against.

items.title: 73 more AnalysisStore reads end their row loop on any terminal code
items.reason: The transcript read was one of 74. Rank the rest by whether an empty result changes a DECISION; convert those first. A scheduler that reads 'no rows' as 'nothing to do' does not recover on the next poll.

items.title: Terminals that name an absence of progress on jobs that made progress
items.reason: Four witnessed on the 09-08 device: expiredWithoutProgress on jobs holding an advanced cursor and landed scan rows.

items.title: A job that cannot finish in any window retries forever and holds the queue head
items.reason: Not on the device today (analysis_jobs all complete) but real since lmrx. Needs the per-window progress witness this bead says does not exist; processedUnitCount was checked and is not it.

items.title: The library coverage batch's 'never analysed' premise is false
items.reason: Every download registers an asset row now, so the batch's filter selects the wrong population.

items.title: Re-scan the 174 frozen semantic rows at the current transcript version
items.reason: V66 fixed the rate, not the stock. A re-scan raises #5's historical reach from 9 toward 27 and localises Dan's own vetoed mark. Not chosen as a prerequisite for #5.

items.title: Two transcriptVersion namespaces — no pull can recover which text a scan read
items.reason: Upstream of why #21's rows froze. A schema question with a coordinate-system answer.

items.title: A free-mail owner address marks the domain show-owned — gmail.com on 127 of 807 feeds
items.reason: A denylist of platform and free-mail domains at the ownership graph's ingress.

items.title: A .showOwnedDomain cue is negative evidence in the lexical scanner and positive in the metadata ledger
items.reason: Two consumers, opposite signs, one value. Decide which is right before touching either.

items.title: An explicit user override can be walked back to the seed by a veto-then-decay cycle
items.reason: The fidelity ladder says an explicit override outranks inference; decay must not erase it.

items.title: A missed auto-skip receipt dies with the episode
items.reason: A skip missed on the last window of a locked stretch is correctable only until the listener moves on.

items.title: The wq34 applied-row exclusions are keyed on decisionState, so a revision goes silent
items.reason: Key on 'is this the applied material', not on the state string.

items.title: DetectorTrustEntry.observationCount mixes episodes and gestures at its seed
items.reason: Two units in one counter; V58 fixed the per-class count and left the seed.

items.title: podcast_planner_state.observedEpisodeCount counts backfills, not episodes
items.reason: The planner declares a show recall-stable after ~5 backfill runs — half an episode. Decide the column's unit, then reuse the trust claim table or give the planner its own.

items.title: The FM prologue atomizes the transcript and builds the evidence catalog twice per scan
items.reason: Double work on the slowest lane. Build once, pass the catalog through.

items.title: The final pass re-transcribed 7,248 spans and reproduced 7,247 verbatim
items.reason: A pass that changes nothing is cost with no coverage. Decide what the final pass is FOR before deciding what to skip.

items.title: FinalPassRetranscriptionRunner.coversWindow can essentially never fire
items.reason: A per-chunk containment test asked a per-window question.

items.title: wroteNewChunks counts transcript rows, so a fast/final twin reads as new transcription
items.reason: Absorbs nqe3. The telemetry half (chunk_rate_per_sec) is safe to fix alone; the hot-path half changes scheduling and is your call.

items.title: final_pass_jobs retains complete rows for spans no AdWindow holds any more
items.reason: Orphan rows that read as work done on windows that no longer exist.

items.title: recoverOrphans' resume arm resets attemptCount to 0
items.reason: Crash-path recovery forgets a retry budget the in-process path preserves.

items.title: A late background URLSession is discarded with invalidateAndCancel()
items.reason: Cancels transfers it did not start. Needs the session-ownership rule stated, then enforced.

items.title: A background relaunch whose session the daemon refuses never invokes the OS completion handler
items.reason: iOS charges the app for a handler it never calls.

items.title: cancelDownload's attribution reap is conditional on an enumeration now allowed to fail
items.reason: A guard whose false branch makes no claim.

items.title: The download work journal adds an unmeasured store round-trip to the completion path
items.reason: Measure it on device before deciding it is fine; it sits on the 2 s launch scan too.

items.title: The force-quit scan's 2 s SLA is bounded at 10 s, never measured for that call site
items.reason: Instrument a few cold launches, then decide whether a second bound is justified.

items.title: The day-0 kickoff ledger's lastWaitedSeconds excludes the serial-drain wait
items.reason: The very 33 minutes that motivated the durable claim are not in the number.

items.title: A cancelled subdivision loses both its cause and its cost
items.reason: Persists as exceededContextWindow with NULL latency, so a grant that ran out is filed as a prompt too big. Whether .cancelled passes through is a recovery-policy call.

items.title: The app trips MetricKit's 1 GB/day disk-write exception on most days
items.reason: 18 of 29 stability records. Attribute the writer once; #30 and #31 are candidates for a large share.

items.title: The merge gate has no wall-clock ceiling
items.reason: Wedged twice on 09-08; only the log's mtime said so. Move the session runners' wedge watcher into the gate: kill the host by name, print the last test started, exit distinctly.

items.title: A non-fatal #expect followed by a force-unwrap turns a flake into a host crash
items.reason: A crash voids the whole merge gate; the sweep is mechanical once the pattern is written down.

items.title: A test that indexes past an array a mutant shrank crashes the runner and prints green
items.reason: The same trapping-subscript pattern beyond the rediff suites.

items.title: 63 Swift Testing display names are shared by 2+ suites
items.reason: Fix the three MUTATIONS records that name a shared name; the rest is a lint rule or nothing.

items.title: Two SemanticSweepMarkComposer mutation anchors are stale; 107 match nothing today
items.reason: Re-read each mutant aimed at restructured code rather than re-anchoring mechanically.

items.title: The canonical bead-close sequence destroys the gate log that authorised the merge
items.reason: Copy the log before git worktree remove; one line in CLAUDE.md's sequence.

items.title: A sibling canary still reads prefix(3_000) as a function body
items.reason: One line: SwiftSourceInspector.firstBody, plus a bounded-window assertion naming the next real method.
